integrity: All-allocation-size classification follows from explicit graph and compatibility arguments. Exhaustive finite checks are reproducible and are not used to certify the infinite cases. The COD five-cycle reduction is classical matching theory and is not asserted as an independently original theorem.
limitations: Existence of one compatible ordered mating pair after deleting all carriers of any single S-allele; not a survival, fecundity, genetics or empirical breeding claim. Assumes distinct heterozygote types, a fixed strict pollen dominance hierarchy and codominant stigmas. Full text of 1997 original unavailable, leaving historical priority uncertainty.
title: Minimum allele-loss-resilient mating supports under two sporophytic self-incompatibility rules
